preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < len(A) for x in A)
preconditions.description: Every element in A is a valid index within the bounds of A (0 ≤ A[i] < N).
All elements in A are distinct.
The length of A (N) is within the range [1, 20000].

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(set(S)) for i in range(len(A)) for S in [[A[i]] + [A[x] for x in S] while x not in S and (S.append(x) or True) for x in [A[i]]] if S))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the length of the longest set S, where S is constructed by starting at index i, repeatedly applying A[x] until a duplicate is encountered.
